verdict.rationale: Abacum's investor-reporting page claims that as actuals flow in, the narrative updates and the deck builds itself, with no copy-paste between the model, slides and memo. Other pages tie board numbers to a live model and describe forecasting in the same model. This is the story's core, but it rests on brief marketing claims only. Missing for 10: explicit variance-commentary generation, details on board-pack contents, templates and export format, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate a board pack (metrics, variance commentary, forecast) from the live model instead of assembling slides by hand

citations.quote: Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself. No copy-paste between the model, the slides and the memo.
So the number you take to the board is today's, not last close's.
Budgeting and forecasting in one model: top-down targets, bottom-up inputs, live actuals.
